ننتقش (form VIII)
# نَنْتَقِشُ (nantaqišu) /nan.ta.qi.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
# نُنْتَقَشُ (nuntaqašu) /nun.ta.qa.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
# نَنْتَقِشَ (nantaqiša) /nan.ta.qi.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
# نُنْتَقَشَ (nuntaqaša) /nun.ta.qa.ʃa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
